summary: At Gemini at Work 2026 Google introduced the Gemini agent, a single universal agent for work that answers questions, does knowledge work, creates media and writes and runs code from one prompt box and one API, taking objectives rather than instructions. Coworker agents get their own Google Workspace identities, including @agents.company.com email addresses, and see only what users share. Industry specializations for Financial Services and Legal are in preview, with Government, Healthcare and Retail coming. Governance includes identity, authorization, auditing, policy management, Agent Sandbox and Agent Gateway; cost controls include multi-model orchestration, Smart Routing and real-time spend caps. Google said nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 use Gemini Enterprise, nearly 500 customers each processed over one trillion tokens, and SOMPO built over 10,000 custom agents across 34,000 employees.

Gemini is the agent, and the model underneath it is a separate choice.

You can set a hard limit on a project's AI spend in the Cloud Billing Console, and Gemini enforces it.
